# Statue photographs

The figures behind Listen, after the one of a sculpted woman generated for AETHER. Each was cropped, separated from its room, relit and made black and white for `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/art_god_*.jpg`. Those changes are ours; the photographs remain under the licences below.
